app.name: portami
app.tagline: Your bus, live. Anonymous and collaborative.

home.subtitle: Where are we going today?
home.noNearby: No routes found nearby. Turn on GPS or explore the map.

trip.endConfirm: Are you sure you want to end the trip? We will stop sharing your location.
trip.endedAuto: We detected you got off. Trip ended automatically.
trip.permissionNeeded: We need GPS access to track your trip
trip.gpsNeeded: portami needs your GPS to show other users where you are and calculate your arrival time.

invite.title: Invite {{name}} via another app
invite.subtitle: Generate a link you can send via WhatsApp, Telegram or SMS. When they open it in portami, they'll start receiving your trip.
invite.notSupported: Your browser doesn't support WebRTC; we can't create the link.

connect.title: Receive invitation
connect.subtitle: {{alias}} wants to share their trip with you.
connect.sendBack: Send this answer back to {{alias}} via the same app
connect.answerCopyHint: Copy this link and paste it in your chat with {{alias}}

connect.notForYou: This answer is not for you
connect.notForYouFor: This answer is not for you — the invitation was for #{{anonId}}
connect.success: Connected! You'll receive the trip live.

testing.title: Testing mode
testing.subtitle: Turn this on to run portami with simulated data. Useful for demos or when the server is down.
testing.enableHint: When on, all server data comes from local mocks and you can pick whether GPS is real or simulated.
testing.databaseNote: Your local database is preserved when toggling this mode.
testing.applied: Testing mode applied. Reload the tab if the app is already open.

routeDetail.etaTooltip: Approximate calculation based on bus speed
routeDetail.etaDisclaimer: Calculated from #{{id}}'s position. It's an estimate — it may vary with traffic, lights and stops.

stopAlerts.title: Stop alerts
stopAlerts.subtitle: Vibration + loud sound when you're close. Adapts to traffic.
stopAlerts.adaptive: Adapts to speed: in traffic sounds closer; fast, earlier.
stopAlerts.hint1: Alert almost on arrival (≈ 100–300 m in city bus).
stopAlerts.hint3: Useful if you're distracted or reading.
stopAlerts.hint4: Lots of advance — you may have already noticed earlier.
stopAlerts.distanceHint: Fixed distance. Useful if the app doesn't get your speed (GPS stopped).
stopAlerts.empty: No alerts set. Add one so we can notify you as you approach a stop.

stopRequest.title: How to request a stop
stopRequest.emptyDesc: No info yet. If you take this bus, tell us how to request a stop.

type.buttonHint: The bus has a button to request a stop
type.voiceHint: You have to tell the driver
type.appHint: The operator has an app to request a stop
type.unknownHint: Not sure, I haven't taken this bus yet

stopRequest.notesPlaceholder: E.g.: "The button is next to the back door, marked in red"
stopRequest.busesDesc: Buses change frequently. If you take one, note the plate — it helps the next traveller.
stopRequest.hadButtonLabel: Did it have a stop button?

board.title: Board a bus/train
board.noMatch: No matching routes. Is this a new trip?
board.confirm: Is it one of these routes? The closer, the more likely.
board.recordNew: None match — record a new one

eta.title: Estimated time of arrival
eta.disclaimer: Calculated from the bus's current position. This is an estimate — actual arrival may vary with traffic, signals and stops.

record.title: Route name
record.minStops: We need at least 3 detected stops
record.minDistance: Recorded route is too short (minimum 500 m)
record.trimTip: Trim the edges and remove sections that don't belong to the route
record.saveSuccess: Route saved and sent to the server
record.saveOffline: Route saved locally; will sync when online
record.namingHint: Use the name people would use to recognize it
record.permissionDenied: GPS permission denied. Enable it in your browser settings and try again.
record.geoNotSupported: Your browser doesn't support geolocation. Use a modern browser or try demo mode.
record.notEnoughSamples: We need more samples to form a route
record.nameRequired: Enter a name for the route

proposal.title: Propose change
proposal.describeTitleHint: E.g.: New stop at Main Square
proposal.yourProposal: You can't vote on your own proposal
proposal.applied: Your proposal was applied to the route
proposal.rejectedNotif: Your proposal was rejected by the community

sync.verifyMatch: Check that the code matches on both devices
sync.codeMismatch: Codes don't match. Pairing aborted for safety.
sync.intro: Sync your identity, routes and proposals with another device via WebRTC. No intermediary server.
sync.pasteOfferTitle: Paste offer from the other device
sync.pasteOfferDesc: Copy the offer SDP your friend gave you and paste it here.
sync.initiatorHint: Copy this code and paste it on the other device. Then paste the other device's answer below.
sync.joinerHint: Your answer code will be shown below. Copy it on the initiator device.
sync.pasteAnswerLabel: Paste the other device's answer here:
sync.verifyMatchHint: Check that the code matches on both devices

settings.title: Settings
settings.identitySubtitle: Anonymous, generated on this device. No accounts or servers.
settings.identityPublicHint: This is your public identity. Other users see it when you share a trip or a route.
settings.publicKeyHint: Only needed for auditing or technical support. Don't share it unless you know what it's for.
settings.regenerateHint: Regenerating your identity will invalidate it. You'll lose reputation and your paired devices will be disconnected. This action cannot be undone.
settings.syncSubtitle: Pass your identity and routes to another phone or computer via WebRTC. No servers.
settings.exportIdDesc: Choose a password to protect the file (minimum 8 characters). You'll need it to import it again. Don't lose it.
settings.importIdDesc: Enter the password from the backup file.
settings.regenerateIdDesc: Your current anonId will be invalidated. You'll lose reputation and your paired devices will be disconnected. This action cannot be undone.
settings.revokeDesc: The device will stop receiving your trips. The active WebRTC connection will close.
settings.regenerateWarn: This will invalidate your reputation and disconnect your paired devices.
settings.privacyText: portami collects no personal data. Your identity is an Ed25519 keypair generated on your device. Your location is NOT shared by default: it's only sent to friends you explicitly invite to a trip, and you can stop sharing at any time, even before getting off the bus. When you share, the connection is direct between your device and your friend's (P2P, never through our servers).

flash.identityExported: Identity exported. Save the file in a safe place.

server.stopped: Server down — retrying for a few minutes…
server.offline: Offline mode — trips only saved on this device

trip.private: Your location is NOT being shared
trip.privateHint: Only the friends you explicitly invite to this trip can see where you are. You can stop sharing at any time, even before getting off.
trip.peerToPeer: Direct device-to-device, not through the server
trip.peerToPeerLong: Your location goes directly to your friend's device — not through our servers. Nobody in the middle sees it.
trip.serverSync: Every minute, the server saves your latest GPS position
trip.serverSyncLong: The server keeps the last known position of your trip. If you run out of battery, your paired friends can see where you were last seen so they can come find you.
trip.serverSyncNoPublic: Your trip is NOT published to third parties or used to compute public bus arrival times. Only your paired friends can consult it.
trip.privacyDetailsTitle: Who can see where I am?
trip.sharingFrequency: Your location is sent every minute to each paired friend.
trip.stopSharingHint: It will also stop automatically when you get off the bus.

share.noRecipients: You don't have any paired friends yet. Pair one from Settings → Sync.

journey.title: How to get there
journey.intro: Plan a door-to-door trip combining bus and train, sorted by transfers.
journey.pickOnMapHint: Tap the map to place the pin, or drag it to fine-tune.
journey.avoidRunning: Avoid having to run between transfers
journey.mayTakeSeconds: This may take a few seconds.
journey.noResultsHint: There's no bus/train combination connecting your origin with your destination at this time.

collaborate.title: Collaborate mode
collaborate.subtitle: Contribute your GPS to the server so others can see where your bus is going
collaborate.description: When on, your GPS position is sent to the server every minute while you're on a trip. This lets the rest of the users (not just your paired friends) see where your bus or train is in real time. You can disable it at any time.
collaborate.notTheServer: goes directly to their devices (P2P), not through the server. Collaborate mode is a fully separate channel from the friend-sharing one.

passphrase.label: Passphrase
passphrase.tooShort: Passphrase must be at least {{n}} characters.

following.title: Following
following.emptyText: When someone paired with you starts a trip, it will appear here.

board.title: Board a bus/train
board.permissionDenied: GPS permission denied. Enable it in your browser settings and try again.
board.permissionError: Your browser does not support geolocation. Use a modern browser or try the demo mode.
board.gpsNeeded: We need GPS access to find which route matches you.
board.locatingHint: We need your GPS to look for routes passing nearby.
board.noMatchHint: No registered routes within 3 km. Is this a new route?
